repos.description: A collective list of free APIs
repos.summary_zh: Public APIs是一个由社区维护的免费API目录，汇集金融、天气、地理定位、电信等多领域公共接口。该项目通过人工审核机制确保API质量，为开发者提供免费、可直接集成的RESTful服务资源。作为开发者的API宝库，它简化了寻找可靠第三方服务的流程，支持快速原型开发和产品功能扩展，是集成外部服务的理想起点。
repos.summary_en: The Public APIs repository is a community-curated directory offering free RESTful APIs across diverse domains including finance, weather, geolocation, and telecommunications. Manually reviewed for quality, this collection serves as a valuable resource for developers seeking reliable third-party services without cost. It streamlines API discovery for rapid prototyping and product development, featuring categories like stock market data, IP geolocation, weather information, and phone validation. The project is maintained by both community contributors and APILayer, ensuring ongoing updates and a well-organized structure.

repos.description: User-friendly AI Interface (Supports Ollama, OpenAI API, ...)
repos.summary_zh: Open WebUI是功能完备的自托管AI平台，无缝集成Ollama与OpenAI API，支持完全离线部署。内置RAG推理引擎和原生Python函数调用工具，提供细粒度用户权限管理、响应式界面及PWA移动应用。支持语音/视频通话、Markdown/LaTeX渲染，可通过插件系统扩展功能。提供Docker/Kubernetes部署方案，适用于企业级AI应用开发与私有化大模型部署场景。
repos.summary_en: Open WebUI is a comprehensive self-hosted AI platform that seamlessly integrates Ollama and OpenAI-compatible APIs with full offline deployment capability. Featuring a built-in RAG inference engine and native Python function calling tools, it offers granular user permissions, responsive design, and PWA mobile support. The platform enables voice/video calls, Markdown/LaTeX rendering, and extensible plugin architecture. Deployable via Docker/Kubernetes, it serves as an enterprise-grade solution for private LLM orchestration and AI application development requiring air-gapped security.

repos.description: AI agent toolkit: unified LLM API, agent loop, TUI, coding agent CLI
repos.summary_zh: Pi 是一个自扩展的 AI 编码 Agent 工具链，提供统一的 LLM API 抽象层，支持 OpenAI、Anthropic、Google 等多模型提供商。包含交互式 CLI、终端 UI 库和 Slack 机器人，具备工具调用和状态管理能力。专为开发者设计，通过真实开源项目会话数据持续优化，实现生产级 AI 自动化编程。
repos.summary_en: Pi is a self-extensible AI coding agent toolkit featuring a unified LLM API abstraction layer supporting multiple providers like OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google. It includes an interactive CLI, terminal UI library with differential rendering, web UI components, and Slack bot integration with robust tool calling and state management capabilities. Designed for developers, it enables production-grade AI automation programming and continuously improves through real-world open-source session data collection and sharing, with hardened supply-chain security for enterprise deployment.

repos.description: Give your AI agent eyes to see the entire internet. Read & search Twitter, Reddit, YouTube, GitHub, Bilibili, XiaoHongShu — one CLI, zero API fees.
repos.summary_zh: Agent-Reach 为 AI 智能体提供命令行式全网接入，支持 Twitter、Reddit、YouTube、B站、小红书等平台，自动处理认证与反爬，零 API 费用实现跨平台内容读取与搜索。
repos.summary_en: Agent-Reach is a CLI tool that equips AI agents with cross-platform internet access across Twitter, Reddit, YouTube, Bilibili, and XiaoHongShu. It automatically handles authentication, anti-bot measures, and data cleaning—zero API fees, one command to install.

repos.description: The fastest, litest AI Gateway. Rust core with Python SDK. Call 100+ LLM APIs in OpenAI (or native) format with cost tracking, guardrails, load balancing, and logging [Bedrock, Azure, OpenAI, Anthropic, OpenAI, VertexAI, vLLM, Nvidia NIM]
repos.summary_zh: LiteLLM 是一个统一的大语言模型网关和 Python SDK，可将 100+ 种 LLM API 转换为 OpenAI 格式调用。提供代理服务器模式，集成成本追踪、负载均衡、安全护栏和日志监控等企业级功能。支持 Bedrock、Azure、Anthropic 等主流平台，简化多模型管理和切换，适用于需要统一 AI 接口、成本控制和生产级部署的场景。
repos.summary_en: LiteLLM is a unified LLM gateway and Python SDK that standardizes 100+ model APIs into OpenAI format. It offers proxy server mode with enterprise features including cost tracking, load balancing, guardrails, and logging. Supporting major platforms like Bedrock, Azure, and Anthropic, it simplifies multi-model management and switching for production deployments requiring unified AI interfaces and cost control.

repos.description: Open-source AI gateway. Self-hosted LLM gateway with OpenAI-, Claude- and Gemini-compatible APIs, model routing, access control, usage tracking and cost accounting.
repos.summary_zh: New API 是一款下一代 LLM 网关与 AI 资产管理系统，通过协议转换层将各类大模型统一为 OpenAI、Claude、Gemini 兼容接口。提供集中式模型路由、分发与管理能力，支持个人与企业级部署，构建跨模型生态的标准化接入平面。
repos.summary_en: New API is a next-generation LLM gateway and AI asset management system that unifies diverse large language models through protocol conversion layers into OpenAI, Claude, and Gemini-compatible interfaces. It provides centralized model routing, load balancing, and distribution management for both personal and enterprise deployments. Built with Go for high performance, the system acts as a standardized access plane for cross-model ecosystems, enabling seamless integration, governance, and observability of heterogeneous AI assets while maintaining strict API compatibility and enterprise-grade security.

repos.description: Automate browser based workflows with AI
repos.summary_zh: Skyvern 是基于 LLM 和计算机视觉的智能浏览器自动化平台，提供 Playwright 兼容 SDK 和无代码工作流构建器。通过视觉理解替代 XPath 定位，支持未知网站自动化、布局变更自适应，实现跨站点工作流批量执行，显著提升自动化鲁棒性。
repos.summary_en: Skyvern automates browsers using LLMs and vision. Playwright SDK replaces XPath with visual understanding for resilient cross-site workflows.

repos.description: A full-featured, hackable Next.js AI chatbot built by Vercel
repos.summary_zh: Vercel开源的全功能AI聊天机器人模板，基于Next.js 14 App Router与React Server Components构建。集成Vercel AI SDK提供统一LLM API，默认支持xAI，可无缝切换OpenAI等提供商。采用shadcn/ui组件与Tailwind CSS样式，数据持久化依托Neon Serverless Postgres和Vercel Blob存储，内置Auth.js认证。支持一键部署至Vercel，为开发者提供开箱即用的可扩展聊天应用解决方案。
repos.summary_en: Vercel's open-source, full-featured AI chatbot template built with Next.js 14 App Router and React Server Components. Powered by Vercel AI SDK for unified LLM API access, defaulting to xAI while supporting seamless integration with OpenAI, Anthropic, and other providers. Features shadcn/ui components styled with Tailwind CSS, data persistence via Neon Serverless Postgres and Vercel Blob storage, and Auth.js authentication. Enables developers to quickly build and deploy hackable chatbot applications with one-click Vercel deployment.

repos.description: The most intuitive desktop API client. Organize and execute REST, GraphQL, WebSockets, Server Sent Events, and gRPC 🦬
repos.summary_zh: Yaak 是一款隐私优先的跨平台桌面 API 客户端，全面支持 REST、GraphQL、WebSocket、SSE 和 gRPC 协议。基于 Tauri 框架构建，后端采用 Rust 实现高性能与安全性，前端使用 React 提供流畅交互。通过社区许可模式运营，为开发者提供直观、高效的 API 调试与管理解决方案。
repos.summary_en: Yaak is a privacy-first cross-platform desktop API client supporting REST, GraphQL, WebSocket, SSE, and gRPC protocols. Built on Tauri framework with Rust backend and React frontend, it delivers high-performance API debugging experience. Community-funded through license purchases, it offers intuitive interface for developers to organize, test, and manage APIs efficiently.

repos.description: Turn any website into a structured API. Extract, automate, search and monitor the web.
repos.summary_zh: Maxun 是一款开源无代码网页数据平台，可将任意网站转化为结构化 API。它提供四大机器人类型：Extract（支持录制和 AI 自然语言提取）、Scrape（整页转 Markdown/HTML）、Crawl（全站爬取）和 Search（自动化搜索）。平台通过模拟真实用户行为，实现从简单到复杂的自动化数据采集，适用于 AI 工作流、竞品监控和商业智能等场景。
repos.summary_en: Maxun is an open-source no-code web data platform that transforms any website into structured APIs. It offers four robot types: Extract (with Recorder and AI natural language modes), Scrape (full-page to Markdown/HTML), Crawl (entire site crawling), and Search (automated web searches). By emulating real user behavior, it enables automated data collection workflows for AI pipelines, competitive intelligence, and business analytics.

repos.description: Get started with building Fullstack Agents using Gemini 2.5 and LangGraph
repos.summary_zh: 基于Gemini 2.5和LangGraph的全栈研究型智能体快速启动模板。前端采用React，后端使用LangGraph构建具备反思能力的AI代理，可动态生成搜索词、执行网页检索、识别知识缺口并迭代优化，最终生成带引用的权威答案。提供完整的开发热重载流程，是构建生产级研究增强对话AI的典范参考架构。
repos.summary_en: Fullstack research agent quickstart template integrating React frontend with LangGraph backend, powered by Gemini 2.5. The agent implements reflective reasoning to dynamically generate search queries, perform web research via Google Search API, identify knowledge gaps, and iteratively refine its approach until producing comprehensive, cited answers. Includes hot-reloading development workflow and CLI example, serving as a production-ready reference for building sophisticated research-augmented conversational AI systems.

repos.description: Make changes to FMHY
repos.summary_zh: FMHY 是一个社区驱动的免费资源聚合平台，汇集互联网海量免费资源链接索引。项目采用 GitHub 协作模式，提供网站、JSON API 和 Markdown 多格式访问，支持实时更新与备份。核心价值在于为开发者、研究人员和普通用户提供一站式免费资源发现服务，通过开放协作机制确保资源时效性与多样性，是数字资源领域的'开源目录'典范。
repos.summary_en: FMHY is a community-driven free resources aggregation platform that indexes vast free content across the internet. Leveraging GitHub collaboration, it offers multi-format access via website, JSON API, and Markdown exports with real-time updates and backups. The project serves as a one-stop discovery hub for developers, researchers, and general users seeking free tools and media. Its open contribution model ensures resource diversity and timeliness, establishing a paradigm of 'open-source directory' in digital resources.

repos.description: Turn your Notion workspace into a fast, customizable website. Built with Next.js + Notion API, with multi-platform deployment and no self-hosted server required.
repos.summary_zh: NotionNext是基于Next.js与Notion API构建的高颜值静态博客系统，支持Vercel等多种部署方案，实现零服务器成本的网站搭建。专为创作者设计，可将Notion页面无缝转化为博客内容，提供主题定制、SEO优化及自动化部署能力，大幅降低技术门槛。
repos.summary_en: NotionNext is a visually appealing static blog system built with Next.js and Notion API, supporting multiple deployment options like Vercel for zero-server website setup. Designed for creators, it seamlessly transforms Notion pages into blog content with theme customization, SEO optimization, and automated deployment, significantly lowering technical barriers.

repos.description: Agent skill that turns natural language, code, Terraform/K8s, SQL, OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, Protobuf and GraphQL sources into editable, tested draw.io architecture diagrams: incremental sync, multi-view projection, drift diff, CI architecture tests, whiteboard derasterize, interactive HTML/PPTX/Mermaid exports.
repos.summary_zh: drawio-skill 是一款 AI 驱动的技能，将自然语言描述转化为专业的 draw.io 图表。它支持 6 种预设类型（ERD、UML、序列、架构、ML/深度学习、流程图）、代码库（Python/JS/Go/Rust）结构可视化、10,000+ 官方形状搜索及 321 个 AI/LLM 品牌 logo。集成视觉自检与最多 5 轮迭代精炼，自动修复布局问题，支持 PNG/SVG/PDF/JPG 导出。与 Claude、Cursor 等多种 AI 代理兼容，适用于软件架构设计、代码可视化及系统文档生成场景。
repos.summary_en: drawio-skill is an AI agent skill that converts natural language into professional draw.io diagrams. It offers 6 presets (ERD, UML, Sequence, Architecture, ML/Deep Learning, Flowchart), codebase visualization for Python/JS/Go/Rust via Graphviz auto-layout, search across 10,000+ official shapes, and 321 AI/LLM logos. Features vision self-check with up to 5 rounds of refinement, auto-fixes layout issues, and exports to PNG/SVG/PDF/JPG. Compatible with Claude Code, Cursor and other agents, ideal for architecture design, code analysis, and LLM app documentation.

repos.description: Multi-account API gateway for Grok Build, Grok Web, and Grok Console
repos.summary_zh: 基于 FastAPI 构建的 Grok 网关，将 Grok Web 能力转换为 OpenAI 兼容 API，支持流式对话、函数工具调用及文生图/视频功能。提供多账号池管理、额度同步和 Anthropic 协议兼容，内置 Admin 后台与 Web Chat 界面，支持 Docker/Vercel 部署，实现企业级 AI 能力统一管理。
repos.summary_en: Grok2API is a FastAPI-based gateway that converts Grok Web capabilities into OpenAI-compatible APIs, enabling seamless integration with existing LLM applications. It supports streaming/non-streaming conversations, function tool calls, and text/image-to-video generation. Key features include multi-account pool management, quota synchronization, Anthropic protocol compatibility, and local media caching. The solution provides a comprehensive Admin backend and Web UI for management, supporting Docker, Vercel, and Render deployment for unified enterprise AI infrastructure.

repos.description: Open Source LLM Gateway 🦚
repos.summary_zh: Manifest 是开源 LLM 网关，专为 AI Agent 与应用设计。通过统一 OpenAI 兼容端点，智能路由 API Key、订阅与本地模型请求至最优模型，支持 300+ 模型与 35+ 提供商。核心能力包括自动降级与故障自愈、全量请求日志、实时成本追踪与限额告警，消除单一供应商锁定，显著提升 Agent 可靠性并降低调用成本。
repos.summary_en: Manifest is an open-source LLM gateway for AI agents and apps. It unifies API keys, subscriptions, and local models behind one OpenAI-compatible endpoint, intelligently routing requests to the optimal model across 300+ models and 35+ providers. Key features include automatic fallbacks with self-healing, full request logging, real-time cost tracking, and usage limits—eliminating vendor lock-in while boosting agent reliability and cutting costs.

repos.description: 🚀 Free HTTP, SOCKS4, & SOCKS5 proxy list * Updated every 5 minutes * and rotating proxy API (100+ countries)
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库提供免费HTTP、HTTPS、SOCKS4及SOCKS5代理列表，每5分钟自动抓取验证更新，覆盖105国家约3900个有效代理，支持TXT/JSON/CSV多格式，按协议分类且无重复。核心价值是实时可靠的代理资源池，适用于网页爬虫、数据采集、隐私保护及绕过地理限制等场景。技术亮点包括自动化验证、多协议支持、便捷下载及NPM模块集成。
repos.summary_en: The proxifly/free-proxy-list repository provides a free, frequently updated list of HTTP, HTTPS, SOCKS4, and SOCKS5 proxies, fetched and validated every 5 minutes from 105 countries with around 3900 working entries. Available in TXT, JSON, and CSV formats, categorized by protocol and country with no duplicates. Core value lies in delivering real-time, reliable proxy resources ideal for web scraping, data collection, anonymity, and bypassing restrictions. Technical highlights include automated validation, multi-protocol support, easy downloads, and NPM module integration.

repos.description: Open-source auth gateway connecting 1700+ SaaS providers to AI agents through SDK, CLI, MCP, HTTP, and OpenAPI.
repos.summary_zh: OpenConnector 是开源 AI 智能体连接网关，替代 Pipedream/Composio。一次授权连接 1500+ SaaS（GitHub、Gmail、Notion 等），通过 SDK、CLI、MCP、HTTP/OpenAPI 暴露 10000+ 预置 Actions。支持凭证管理、可检查 Action 契约、策略控制与运行日志，可自托管（Docker/Node/K8s）或使用 OOMOL 托管运行时。
repos.summary_en: OpenConnector is an open-source auth gateway for AI agents, an alternative to Pipedream/Composio. Connect 1500+ SaaS providers once and expose 10,000+ prebuilt Actions via SDK, CLI, MCP, HTTP and OpenAPI. It handles credentials, inspectable contracts, policies and logs, supporting self-hosting (Docker/Node/K8s) or OOMOL-hosted runtime.

repos.description: 🏞️ PicX，免费、安全的一站式在线图片处理平台。
repos.summary_zh: PicX 是一款基于 GitHub API 的在线图床管理工具，无需下载安装即可使用。它支持拖拽上传、批量操作、图片压缩和水印处理，提供 Markdown/HTML 等多种链接格式。通过 GitHub OAuth 或 Token 认证，用户可将 GitHub 仓库作为免费图床，配合 jsDelivr 等 CDN 实现高速访问，是开发者和技术写作者的理想图片托管解决方案。
repos.summary_en: PicX is a GitHub API-based online image hosting management tool that requires no download or installation. It supports drag-and-drop upload, batch operations, image compression, and watermarking, providing multiple link formats like Markdown/HTML. Through GitHub OAuth or Token authentication, users can leverage GitHub repositories as free image hosts, combined with CDNs like jsDelivr for high-speed access, making it an ideal image hosting solution for developers and technical writers.

repos.description: Use any LLMs (Large Language Models) for Deep Research. Support SSE API and MCP server.
repos.summary_zh: Deep Research是一个隐私优先的深度研究工具，支持Gemini、OpenAI、Deepseek等主流大模型，可在2分钟内生成综合性研究报告。核心亮点包括：浏览器端本地数据处理确保隐私安全；支持Searxng、Tavily等搜索引擎；提供知识图谱构建和本地知识库管理；支持MCP服务器和SSE API。基于Next.js构建，可一键部署至Vercel或Cloudflare，适用于快速调研和知识整理场景。
repos.summary_en: Deep Research is a privacy-first deep research tool that leverages multiple LLMs (Gemini, OpenAI, Deepseek, etc.) to generate comprehensive reports in approximately 2 minutes. Key features include local browser-side data processing for privacy, integration with search engines like Searxng and Tavily, knowledge graph generation, and local knowledge base management. Built with Next.js, it supports MCP server and SSE API, offering one-click deployment to Vercel or Cloudflare. Ideal for rapid research and knowledge organization with full data control.

repos.summary_zh: dg-ai-notes 是冬瓜的 AI 学习笔记仓库，专注 Pi-Agent SDK 深度教程。Pi-Agent 作为生产级 AI Agent 运行时底座，提供 Agent Loop、工具系统、消息系统、事件驱动及会话管理等核心能力。教程分 10 章系统拆解源码设计，每章涵盖概念、实现与设计取舍，提供 TypeScript 和 Python 双版本对照，支持在线 Web 阅读、Markdown 下载、PDF 及 Notebook 实验。帮助开发者理解生产级 Agent 架构，搭建可靠 AI 应用。
repos.summary_en: dg-ai-notes is Winter Melon's AI learning notes repo focused on an in-depth tutorial for the Pi-Agent SDK. Pi-Agent is a production-grade runtime base for AI Agents, featuring Agent Loop, tool system, messaging, event-driven architecture, and session management. The 10-chapter tutorial dissects source code design with both TypeScript and Python versions, offering web reading, Markdown/PDF downloads, and an interactive notebook. It helps developers understand and build reliable AI Agent systems.

repos.description: ✦ Gemini ➜ OpenAI API proxy. Serverless!
repos.summary_zh: 该项目是一个OpenAI API格式的代理，将请求转发至Google Gemini API。利用Gemini免费层的慷慨额度，让仅支持OpenAI接口的开发者工具无缝切换至Gemini模型。支持Vercel、Netlify、Cloudflare Workers等Serverless平台一键部署，无需服务器维护，同时提供Node、Deno、Bun本地运行方案，突破地域限制。
repos.summary_en: This project provides a serverless proxy that translates OpenAI API requests to Google Gemini API format. By leveraging Gemini's generous free tier, it enables developers to use OpenAI-exclusive tools with Gemini models at zero cost. Supports one-click deployment to Vercel, Netlify, Cloudflare Workers, and Deno Deploy without server maintenance. Offers local development via Node, Deno, or Bun, allowing users outside supported regions to obtain API keys via VPN and access Gemini's powerful models seamlessly.

repos.description: Fractal Graph-of-Thought. Rhizomatic Mind-Mapping for Ai-Agents, Web-Links, Notes, and Code.
repos.summary_zh: Neurite 采用分形几何与图论构建无限维思维导图，融合AI代理与多模态节点（代码/链接/笔记）。支持多代理协同与神经网络API，为创意协作与知识管理提供非线性、自相似的可视化工作空间。
repos.summary_en: Neurite is an open-source fractal-based mind-mapping platform that merges chaos theory with graph theory to create an infinite-dimensional digital workspace. It interconnects AI agents, code snippets, notes, and web links as nodes in a rhizomatic structure. Key features include multi-agent UI collaboration, FractalGPT integration, a Neural API, and synchronized knowledge management. The system enables non-linear creative thinking by revealing hidden patterns through self-similar fractal geometries, transforming how complex information is organized and visualized.

repos.description: A wrapper that exposes Google AI Studio Build as OpenAI, Gemini, and Anthropic compatible APIs.（一个将 Google AI Studio Build 封装为兼容 OpenAI / Gemini / Anthropic 风格 API 的工具）
repos.summary_zh: AIStudioToAPI 是一个将 Google AI Studio 网页端封装为兼容 OpenAI、Gemini 和 Anthropic API 格式的代理工具。它利用浏览器自动化技术实现多账号管理、工具调用及生图/TTS 模型访问，提供可视化 Web 控制台和 VNC 登录功能，便于开发者将 AI Studio 能力无缝集成到现有应用。
repos.summary_en: AIStudioToAPI is a wrapper that converts Google AI Studio's web interface into OpenAI, Gemini, and Anthropic-compatible API formats. Leveraging browser automation, it supports multi-account management, function calling, and access to Gemini models for image generation and text-to-speech. The tool provides a web console with VNC login capabilities, enabling seamless integration of AI Studio features into existing applications.

repos.summary_zh: Grok2API 基于 FastAPI 构建 Grok 网关，将 Grok Web 能力转为 OpenAI 兼容 API，支持聊天补全、图像编辑、视频生成及 Anthropic 接口。核心亮点包括多账号池管理、流式输出、工具调用、本地缓存与自动维护。提供 Docker 一键部署（含防 Cloudflare 方案）、内置 Admin 后台与 WebUI，适用于 AI 应用集成与多模态内容生成。
repos.summary_en: Grok2API is a FastAPI-based Grok gateway exposing web capabilities via OpenAI-compatible APIs for chat, image editing, video generation, and Anthropic endpoints. Key highlights: multi-account pooling, streaming, tool calling, local caching, auto-maintenance. Offers Docker deployment with anti-CF options, admin panel, and WebUIs. Ideal for AI app integration and multimodal tasks.

repos.description: WebAI2API: 基于 Camoufox 的网页 AI 转 API 工具，支持 LMArena/Gemini等，多窗口并发与账号隔离。 | Web AI to OpenAI API via Camoufox. Supports LMArena/Gemini and more, multi-window concurrency & account isolation.
repos.summary_zh: WebAI2API是基于Camoufox的网页AI服务转API工具，支持LMArena/Gemini/ChatGPT等20+平台。通过拟人化操作模拟规避检测，提供OpenAI格式接口，支持多窗口并发与账号级浏览器隔离，内置任务队列和故障转移机制，配备可视化管理界面，实现高效稳定的AI服务调用。
repos.summary_en: WebAI2API converts web-based AI services (LMArena/Gemini/ChatGPT etc.) into OpenAI-compatible APIs using Camoufox. It simulates human-like interactions to bypass detection, supports multi-window concurrency with account isolation, and includes task queuing, failover mechanisms, plus a web management interface for stable AI service integration.

repos.description: This is a project that unifies the management of LLM APIs. It can call multiple backend services through a unified API interface, convert them to the OpenAI format uniformly, and support load balancing. Currently supported backend services include: OpenAI, Anthropic, DeepBricks, OpenRouter, Gemini, Vertex, etc.
repos.summary_zh: uni-api 统一管理 OpenAI、Anthropic、Gemini 等主流 LLM API，转换为标准 OpenAI 格式。支持权重/地域/轮询四种负载均衡、自动重试与渠道冷却机制，纯配置文件管理，无前端依赖，适合个人部署。
repos.summary_en: uni-api unifies LLM APIs into OpenAI format. Supports 4 load balancing types, auto-retry, channel cooling, pure config management, no frontend, ideal for personal deployment.

repos.description: 使用Telegram作为存储的文件外链系统，不限制文件大小和格式。
repos.summary_zh: tgState 是一款创新的文件外链系统，深度利用 Telegram 的 Bot API 和 FileID 机制，将 Telegram 频道/群组作为无限容量存储后端。系统支持任意大小格式的文件存储分发，提供 Web 界面和 API 上传接口，可作为图床或私有网盘使用。支持 Docker、Vercel 等多种部署方式，配合 CloudFlare 可实现高效 CDN 加速。
repos.summary_en: tgState is an innovative file hosting system that leverages Telegram's Bot API and FileID mechanism to utilize Telegram channels/groups as unlimited-capacity storage backend. Supporting files of any size and format, it provides both web interface and API for uploads, functioning as image hosting or private cloud storage. Features flexible deployment via Docker, Vercel, or binary, with CloudFlare CDN integration for optimized content delivery.

repos.description: Python library for Agentic Document Extraction (ADE).
repos.summary_zh: LandingAI ADE Python库提供智能文档提取能力，支持同步/异步调用与大规模文档处理。基于Pydantic构建全类型SDK，内置指数退避重试机制，可插拔HTTP后端。通过MCP服务器无缝集成AI助手，实现文档结构化数据提取自动化。适用于金融、法律、医疗等领域的非结构化文档转结构化数据场景，提升数据处理效率。
repos.summary_en: LandingAI ADE Python library enables intelligent document extraction via agentic AI. Features fully-typed SDK with Pydantic models, sync/async clients, and built-in exponential backoff retries. Supports large document processing through async jobs and pluggable HTTP backends (httpx/aiohttp). MCP server integration allows AI assistants to interact with the API seamlessly. Ideal for automating structured data extraction from unstructured documents in finance, legal, healthcare and other domains, transforming PDFs and images into machine-readable JSON with schema-based precision, high reliability and production-ready performance.

repos.description: 🚀 OpenAI-compatible Freebuff proxy with dynamic free-agent tracking, token rotation, and ready-to-use Docker deployment.
repos.summary_zh: Freebuff2API 是一个 OpenAI 兼容代理服务器，将 Freebuff 免费 AI 模型转换为标准 OpenAI API 格式。支持多账号 token 自动轮换提升调用额度，动态模拟官方 SDK 指纹规避检测，并提供 Docker 快速部署。适用于开发者在不更换现有 OpenAI SDK 代码的前提下，零成本调用 Freebuff 的 AI 模型服务。
repos.summary_en: Freebuff2API is an OpenAI-compatible proxy server that transforms Freebuff's free AI models into standard OpenAI API endpoints. It features automatic multi-token rotation for higher throughput, dynamic client fingerprinting to mimic official SDK behavior, and Docker deployment. Enables developers to use Freebuff's AI services with any OpenAI-compatible client without code changes.

repos.description: DeepSeek 逆向 API
repos.summary_zh: DeepSeek2API通过逆向工程将DeepSeek模型封装为OpenAI兼容接口，支持deepseek-chat、deepseek-reasoner等模型。核心特性包括高速流式输出、多轮对话、R1深度思考及多账号轮换机制，有效分散单账号风险。提供Docker、Vercel及原生部署方案，配置灵活。项目明确声明仅限研究学习使用，禁止商用，规避官方服务压力与封号风险。
repos.summary_en: DeepSeek2API wraps DeepSeek models into OpenAI-compatible interfaces via reverse engineering, supporting deepseek-chat, deepseek-reasoner and search variants. Key features include high-speed streaming output, multi-turn conversation, R1 deep reasoning, and multi-account rotation to mitigate single-account limitations. Offers flexible deployment via Docker, Vercel, or native Python. Project explicitly for research/learning only, prohibiting commercial use to avoid official service pressure and account bans.

repos.description: 一个透明的 Tavily API 反向代理：将多个 Tavily API Key（额度/credits）汇聚在一个 Master Key 之后，并提供内置 Web UI 用于管理 Key、用量与请求日志。
repos.summary_zh: TavilyProxyManager 是一个专为 Tavily API 设计的高可用代理网关，核心解决多 API Key 的额度聚合与智能调度问题。通过 Master Key 统一鉴权，实现基于剩余额度的动态负载均衡与自动故障切换，有效规避频率限制。内置 Vue3 管理面板提供 Key 管理、用量监控与请求日志分析，同时集成 MCP 协议端点，无缝对接 Claude 等 AI 工具。Go 语言构建，单二进制部署，Docker 开箱即用。
repos.summary_en: TavilyProxyManager is a high-availability proxy gateway designed for Tavily API, solving multi-key quota aggregation and intelligent scheduling. It unifies authentication via Master Key, implements dynamic load balancing based on remaining credits with automatic failover to avoid rate limits. The built-in Vue3 dashboard provides key management, usage monitoring, and request log analysis, while integrated MCP protocol endpoints seamlessly connect with AI tools like Claude. Built with Go, it offers single-binary deployment and Docker-ready out-of-the-box.

repos.description: 智谱清言网页版的 Cloudflare Worker 2API层，提供 OpenAI / Claude / Gemini 三种协议兼容接口，支持流式对话、Tools调用、AI 绘图、视频生成与多账号 Token 轮询。
repos.summary_zh: 这是一个将智谱清言私有API转换为标准LLM接口的Cloudflare Worker服务。核心价值在于提供OpenAI、Claude、Gemini三协议兼容，支持流式对话、Tools调用、AI绘图与视频生成。通过动态Token轮询和自动补号机制，实现多账号资源池化与零维护，让任意兼容客户端无缝调用GLM系列模型能力。
repos.summary_en: This Cloudflare Worker service converts ChatGLM's private streaming API into standardized LLM service interfaces, delivering seamless OpenAI, Claude, and Gemini protocol compatibility. Key features include streaming responses with reasoning content, dynamic token management with round-robin scheduling, automated token replenishment, and support for AI drawing, video generation, and function calling. The architecture separates authentication from resource tokens, enabling unified management of multiple accounts while providing zero-maintenance operation for any compatible client applications.

repos.description: Automated QwenCloud account registration & API key harvester with multi-threading, TUI dashboard, proxy rotation, and Gmail OAuth
repos.summary_zh: QwenCloud Generator是一款自动化QwenCloud账户注册与API密钥采集工具，支持多线程Playwright浏览器并发操作、TUI实时仪表盘监控、代理轮换及Gmail OAuth邮箱验证。适用于AI开发者批量获取Qwen大模型API访问权限的场景，具备无头模式、自动恢复和页面状态智能检测等亮点，大幅提升注册效率与匿名性。
repos.summary_en: QwenCloud Generator automates QwenCloud account registration and API key harvesting using multi-threaded Playwright browsers, a TUI dashboard, proxy rotation, and Gmail OAuth for verification. Ideal for AI developers needing bulk API access to Qwen models, it supports headless mode via Xvfb, auto-resume, and scenario detection to handle signup flows efficiently and scalably.

repos.description: spoo.me is an open-source & API first link management infra
repos.summary_zh: spoo.me 是一个开源、API 优先的短链接管理服务，提供自定义 slug（含 emoji）、密码保护、点击限制等高级功能。其核心亮点在于强大的分析能力，支持地理位置、设备、流量模式、引荐来源和机器人检测的多维度统计，并提供 CSV/JSON/XLSX/XML 数据导出。无需注册即可使用，支持自托管，完全免费且无功能限制，适合需要私有化部署或集成短链能力的开发者和企业。
repos.summary_en: spoo.me is an open-source, API-first URL shortening infrastructure offering advanced features like custom slugs (including emojis), password protection, and click limits. Its core strength lies in comprehensive analytics covering geographic distribution, device breakdown, traffic patterns, referrer tracking, and bot detection, with multi-format data export (CSV/JSON/XLSX/XML). Requiring no registration, it provides completely free unlimited usage with self-hosting capability. Ideal for developers and enterprises needing private deployment or integrated link management with detailed click insights.

repos.description: 将ai studio的对话页面转发为api接口，供其他软件使用。您可以在releases中使用稳定版本和开发测试版
repos.summary_zh: 该项目通过油猴脚本与本地 Python 服务器协同，将 AI Studio 对话页面桥接为 OpenAI API 兼容接口。核心亮点是完整支持函数调用（Function Calling）和动态模型列表获取，实现端到端自动化。用户可定义工具，AI 自动触发调用并返回结构化响应，支持并行调用与流式返回，无缝集成现有开发工具链。
repos.summary_en: This project bridges AI Studio chat pages into OpenAI API-compatible interfaces through Tampermonkey scripts and local Python servers. Its core innovation lies in full Function Calling support and dynamic model fetching, enabling complete end-to-end automation. Users can define custom tools that AI automatically triggers based on context, receiving structured responses with parallel invocation and streaming output. The system handles the entire interaction loop—from tool execution to result submission—providing a standardized API layer that seamlessly integrates with existing development toolchains, libraries, and workflows without modification.

repos.description: 基于 Cookie/Token 认证、自动绕过 Cloudflare (CF) 人机验证、高级反检测伪装、高速流式 API 转换、Docker 一键部署
repos.summary_zh: notion-2api 是一个将 Notion AI 非官方接口转换为 OpenAI 兼容格式的高性能代理层。基于 FastAPI 和 cloudscraper 实现 Cloudflare 绕过与反检测，支持流式响应和多模型调用。Docker 一键部署让任意 OpenAI API 客户端无缝接入 Notion AI 能力，适用于自动化脚本、AI 应用集成等场景。
repos.summary_en: notion-2api is a high-performance proxy service that transforms Notion AI's unofficial backend into a fully compatible OpenAI API interface. Leveraging FastAPI and cloudscraper, it automatically bypasses Cloudflare protection while implementing advanced anti-detection mechanisms. The solution supports real-time streaming responses (stream=true) and maintains session state across multiple models. With Docker-based deployment, developers can instantly provision a private API endpoint, enabling any OpenAI-compatible application or script to harness Notion AI's capabilities without official API access.

repos.description: 基于 FastAPI 重构的 Grok2API，适配最新的Web调用格式，支持流式对话、图像生成、图像编辑、联网搜索、视频生成、深度思考，支持号池并发调用和自动负载均衡。
repos.summary_zh: Tomiya233/grok2api 将 xAI 的 Grok 大模型封装为 OpenAI API 兼容接口，基于 FastAPI 构建。核心亮点包括：异步流式处理架构确保高并发性能，智能号池管理与负载均衡机制最大化调用稳定性，自动缓存解决资源链接 403 限制，提供完整的管理界面与统计监控。适用于需要将 Grok 集成至现有 AI 应用或构建高可用 Grok 服务的开发者。
repos.summary_en: Tomiya233/grok2api wraps xAI's Grok model into OpenAI API-compatible interfaces using FastAPI. Key features include: asynchronous streaming architecture for high concurrency, intelligent token pool management with auto load balancing, automatic caching to bypass 403 restrictions, and comprehensive admin dashboard with statistics. Enables developers to integrate Grok into existing AI applications or build highly available Grok services with enterprise-grade reliability.

repos.summary_zh: Sprite Lab是一款纯浏览器端工具，专为图像背景去除与精灵图自动切割设计。无需上传或AI模型，利用Canvas API实现多通道alpha抠图消除边缘光晕，并通过连通像素扫描智能检测帧。支持动画预览、帧排除及ZIP导出（含manifest），全部本地处理，保障隐私与离线可用。适用于2D游戏开发和动画资产准备。
repos.summary_en: Sprite Lab is a fully client-side web tool for automatic background removal and spritesheet slicing. Using only the HTML Canvas API, it detects backdrops like green screens or checkerboards and applies multi-pass alpha matting to eliminate edge halos. Connected pixel analysis enables intelligent frame detection without grids. Features include animation previews, frame exclusion, and ZIP exports with manifests. Everything runs locally with no uploads, AI, or servers—ideal for 2D game asset preparation.

repos.description: 极简 Cloudflare Worker，接收私人域名邮件并提供 HTTP API 读取
repos.summary_zh: ni-mail 是一个极简 Cloudflare Worker，通过 Email Routing 接收私人域名邮件并提供 HTTP API 读取。使用 KV 存储最多 50 封邮件，postal-mime 解析为结构化 JSON，支持 API Key 鉴权和多自定义域名，附件仅存 metadata。无需数据库、前端或 JWT，部署简单，适合自动化脚本获取邮件内容，实现轻量级邮件集成。
repos.summary_en: ni-mail is a minimalist Cloudflare Worker that receives private domain emails via Cloudflare Email Routing and exposes them through a simple HTTP API. It stores up to 50 emails in KV, parses them with postal-mime into structured JSON, supports API key auth and multiple custom domains, and keeps only attachment metadata. No database, frontend or JWT needed; ideal for automation scripts fetching emails in a lightweight, serverless setup.

repos.description: TypeScript SDK for the NitroPing audit log — batching client, error capture, Hono/Express/Nitro adapters, and GenAI cost tracing.
repos.summary_zh: nitroping-sdk 是 nitroping.dev 平台的官方多语言客户端库，支持 TypeScript、Swift、Python、Go、Kotlin、PHP 等语言，封装 REST API 实现设备令牌注册（APNs/FCM/Web Push）、多渠道通知发送（推送、邮件、SMS、Slack）、定向/定时/循环推送、Web Push 订阅与 UI 组件、内置收件箱及 Webhook 验证。适用于移动/Web 应用与服务器端通知集成，提供统一 API、公私钥认证和幂等性支持，实现跨平台一致体验。
repos.summary_en: nitroping-sdk offers official client libraries for the nitroping.dev platform across TypeScript, Swift, Python, Go, Kotlin, and PHP. It wraps the REST API for device token registration (APNs/FCM/Web Push), multi-channel notifications (push, email, SMS, Slack), targeted/scheduled/recurring sends, Web Push subscriptions with UI widgets, in-app inbox, and webhook verification. Ideal for mobile/web apps and servers needing unified, secure cross-platform notification delivery with public/secret key auth and idempotency.

repos.summary_zh: jdapi 是一个非官方的京东 API Python 封装库，为开发者提供便捷的京东账号自动化操作能力。项目核心价值在于简化京东登录态管理、签到任务、优惠券领取等常见场景的 API 调用，通过 Python 函数式接口屏蔽底层 HTTP 请求细节。技术亮点包括自动 Cookie 管理、请求加密处理以及反反爬机制，适用于京东生态的自动化脚本开发与轻量级应用集成。
repos.summary_en: jdapi is an unofficial Python wrapper for JD.com APIs, enabling automated account operations with minimal code. It simplifies common scenarios like check-ins, coupon claiming, and order queries by abstracting HTTP complexities into Python functions. Key features include automated cookie management, request encryption, and anti-anti-crawling mechanisms, ideal for building JD ecosystem automation scripts and lightweight integrations.
